purpose.summary: Display a status indicator with a semantic theme (muted, success, warning, danger, info, merged, risk) and optional pulse animation on the 'status' variant
useWhen: Communicating the state of a system, process, or entity (active, pending, error, warning)
Labeling a status alongside other metadata in tables, lists, or cards
Showing pulse animation for real-time status (e.g., 'currently processing')
doNotUseWhen: Displaying actionable tags or filters (use Tag component)
Showing progress or completion percentage (use Progress component)

shared.name: variant
shared.codeNote: Component style variant. Defaults to 'outline' when omitted; pass another only when the design calls for it. 'status' (dot plus label) is the only variant that takes pulse, and the only one that cannot take an icon.

shared.name: theme
shared.codeNote: Semantic color theme indicating the status type

shared.name: children
shared.figmaNote: Exposed in Figma as the TEXT property 'textString#1299:25'. Figma holds plain text only; the code prop accepts any ReactNode.

codeOnly.name: icon
codeOnly.notes: Optional IconV2 name (a key of IconNameMapV2). Figma does expose icon controls ('viewIcon#1293:13' plus the instance swap '↳ icon#1299:52'), but those select an icon *instance* while this prop takes an icon *name*, and the icon component set has no Code Connect mapping to recover a name from. Agents must supply the name explicitly.

codeOnly.name: pulse
codeOnly.notes: Animates the status indicator dot (CSS animate-pulse). Requires variant='status'; the discriminated union types it as never on every other variant. No Figma property corresponds to it, though the Figma component does draw the indicator dot.

codeOnly.name: className
codeOnly.notes: Additional CSS classes (Tailwind); should not override token-based styling

accessibility.notes: Badge is a passive status indicator; not interactive. It renders a plain div with no ARIA role, so it is not a live region and changes are not announced. Text is the only carrier of meaning. Icon (if present) should be decorative (aria-hidden).

states.name: pulse
states.description: Animated pulse on status indicator dot (variant='status' only)
